fields.measuregrp.attrib: raw: kept in the group context; a manual or unreliable entry sets the manual_entry flag
fields.measuregrp.category: raw: only real measurements (1) are stored, user objectives are skipped
fields.measuregrp.date: raw: timestamp that sets the row time
fields.measuregrp.grpid: raw: identifier (external id of the group)
fields.measuregrp.measures[].position: raw: body part of a segmental measure (173-175), selects the segment code
fields.measuregrp.measures[].type: raw: selects the code (meastype table in the normalizer); 130 and 139 (AFib classification, 0 to 13) become the events afib_ecg_result and afib_ppg_result
fields.measuregrp.measures[].unit: raw: power of ten of the value
